explanation: Fires on the last token of a singular noun or name that closes a modifier (PP, relative or participial phrase) inside a still-open PLURAL subject, at the position right before the main verb, i.e. on a singular agreement attractor where a plural verb is due next ("Key challenges in this [area] include", "findings of this [study] were", "pedidos do [governo] estão", "workers at the [factory] went"). It is near silent when the subject head is singular, when the embedded noun is itself plural, and on ordinary nouns outside such a subject; the pole reads the pending plural subject (retrospective), and its output promotes plural verbs (' are', ' were', 都) and suppresses singular ones (' is', ' was', ' has'), but ablation shifts next-token probability too diffusely to count as lookahead.
